mapper.update: UPDATE r_pan_upload_task SET multipart_id=#{multipartId},final_path=#{locator} WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND direct_upload=TRUE AND task_state='UPLOADING' AND multipart_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT md5 FROM r_pan_upload_part WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND part_number=#{part}
SELECT part_number AS part, md5 FROM r_pan_upload_part WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId}
SELECT * FROM r_pan_upload_task WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE r_pan_upload_task SET task_state='FINALIZING',final_path=#{finalPath},last_error=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND task_state='UPLOADING'

UPDATE r_pan_upload_task SET task_state='COMPLETED',real_file_id=#{realFileId},user_file_id=#{userFileId}, last_error=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND task_state='FINALIZING'
UPDATE r_pan_upload_task SET last_error=#{error},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ,task_state='FAILED' WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND task_state='FINALIZING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM r_pan_upload_task WHERE storage_type=#{storageType} AND artifacts_cleaned_at IS NULL AND ( (task_state='UPLOADING' AND expires_at <= #{now}) OR (task_state='FINALIZING' AND expires_at <= #{now} AND updated_at <= #{stale}) OR task_state='COMPLETED' OR (task_state IN ('EXPIRED','FAILED') AND (final_path IS NULL OR updated_at <= #{abandonedBefore}) )) ORDER BY updated_at,upload_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE r_pan_upload_task SET task_state='EXPIRED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND task_state IN ('UPLOADING','FINALIZING')
UPDATE r_pan_upload_task SET artifacts_cleaned_at=#{now},artifact_cleanup_error=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND task_state IN ('EXPIRED','FAILED','COMPLETED')
